region_scene_page.compact: House emerged from Chicago dance spaces where DJs, drum machines, disco memory, queer nightlife, and Black and Latino club culture made a new electronic pulse.
region_scene_page.standard: House emerged from Chicago dance spaces where DJs, drum machines, disco memory, queer nightlife, and Black and Latino club culture made a new electronic pulse. Steve "Silk" Hurley's Jack Your Body, Farley Jackmaster Funk featuring Darryl Pandy's Love Can't Turn Around, Frankie Knuckles, and Inner City's Good Life give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: House emerged from Chicago dance spaces where DJs, drum machines, disco memory, queer nightlife, and Black and Latino club culture made a new electronic pulse. Unlike techno's colder futurism, house keeps a warmer relationship to disco, soul, vocals, and communal release. Steve "Silk" Hurley's Jack Your Body, Farley Jackmaster Funk featuring Darryl Pandy's Love Can't Turn Around, Frankie Knuckles, and Inner City's Good Life give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
